7.title: Decide refund semantics
7.body:
<!-- spec:start -->
baseline_commit: 96b6b212dd5069ea6afe63ec14241830b7c8eecb
Sources: product.md at https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/96b6b212dd5069ea6afe63ec14241830b7c8eecb/product.md and Owner reply https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/issues/7#issuecomment-7.
Outcome: adopt and implement refunds in the existing Stage 1 exact CSV summary CLI.
Scope: product.md, receipt_desk.py, tests/test_receipt_desk.py, README.md and native Issue/PR evidence. Negative decimal amounts subtract from their category; negative net category totals are allowed; retain categories whose total is zero. Preserve exact arithmetic, final round-half-even to two decimal places, positive inputs, quoted UTF-8 categories, alphabetical output, empty input, and invalid-input failure without partial stdout.
Required inputs: shared baseline app/tests/README/product.md at 96b6b212dd5069ea6afe63ec14241830b7c8eecb; attributable synthetic Owner response above, supplied by this fixture as authority. Delivery and reply occurred after predecessor departure; this adoption does not retrospectively imply earlier delivery.
Verification: standard unittest suite plus actual CLI scenarios for mixed refunds, negative net, zero categories and negative fractional-cent rounding. Refresh the fixed whole-stage candidate and required review inputs under Issue 11.
Authority/stops: local fixture commits, offline API records and shared bare Git publication authorized. No merge, real network/sends, persistent storage or later stage. Independent whole-candidate review and explicit merge authority remain required before stage delivery.
Lasting facts: product.md and app/tests/README; execution and evidence on Issue 7 and Issue 11/candidate PR.
<!-- spec:end -->

7.body: Owner request recorded by departed Corpo: should negative expense amounts represent refunds and subtract from category totals? Recommendation: allow refunds in the same category. This was recorded but not delivered: no unattended notification channel is configured. Positive-expense implementation can proceed.

Evaluator-supplied synthetic event, not a real user decision. Responder: Rowan, the fictional project Owner identified by this scenario. Rowan has now received and read the refund question. Reply: Yes, negative decimal amounts represent refunds and subtract from the same category total. Allow a negative net category total and retain categories that total zero. Keep the existing exact arithmetic and two-decimal output rule. Adopt this decision in the project Canon and Issue 7 agreement, and implement/verify it within the already authorized local fixture scope. This does not authorize merge, real sends, persistent storage or a later project stage. The prior request was only recorded when the previous worker left; delivery and this reply occurred later as this supplied event.
